title.narrative: European Union Scholarships (BEURs)

description.narrative: Contract related to: European Union Scholarships (BEURs) - This proposal envisages the continuation of Facility assistance in the area of education, notably the continuation of PIKTES (Promoting Integration of Syrian Kids into Turkish Education System) and CCTE (Conditional Cash Transfer for Education) projects, and support to higher education including scholarships. The objective is to keep the refugee enrolment numbers up to acceptable levels in order to enable children to obtain their right to education and to help maximise their contribution to the Turkish society and economy. This needs to be achieved while ensuring social cohesion by maintaining the current level of education quality for the host community in the supported education facilities.The measure consists of three components: 1) PIKTES + (covering three school years 2022/23, 2023/24 and 2024/25); 2) CCTE (consisting of cash component and child protection component, covering three school years 2022/23, 2023/24 and 2024/25); and 3) BEUrs (support to higher education including scholarships and related support services).
